[FACT] User asked about the impact of Brexit on currency exchange rates and requested direct evidence.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant explained that the impact of Brexit on currency exchange rates is complex and multifaceted, noting a significant decrease in the value of the British pound (GBP) against other currencies following the Brexit vote in 2016.  
[FACT] Assistant stated that the GBP reached a 31-year low against the USD in October 2016.  
[FACT] Assistant clarified that changes in exchange rates are influenced by various global economic factors, not solely Brexit.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant explained that a weaker currency makes exports cheaper and imports more expensive, impacting trade balance and the economy.
